tasks.description:
Three small documentation-consistency fixes across idea-lab/final_requirements/ (do NOT touch 06_ledger_addendum.md — it is controller ledger work; do NOT touch 00 unless needed). Preserve headers/DEC-n/US-n IDs. NO amount/rail/vendor-name RE-migration (those are done) — this is terminology consistency only.
(1) etsgiin_ner SPACING (#11): the patronymic field is written both as 'etsgiin ner' (space) and 'etsgiin_ner' (underscore). CANONICAL = 'etsgiin_ner' (underscore — matches the ORM field, OpenAPI property, and DEC-6). Replace the free-text 'etsgiin ner' (space) occurrences with 'etsgiin_ner' where they denote the field; leave any genuinely prose-Mongolian usage if it exists (flag if ambiguous).
(2) OTHER-VENDOR ABSTRACTION (#18): the five main vendors were neutralized earlier, but e-signature (DocuSign / Dropbox Sign), notification (SendGrid / Twilio), and any residual Jumio references remain named. Neutralize them to role-abstractions consistent with the DEC-5 pattern: 'the e-signature provider', 'the SMS/notification provider' — provider is a procurement decision (TBD); do NOT invent a Mongolian vendor. Keep any '-class' framing that's already abstract.
(3) 'CENTS' -> 'MINOR UNITS' (#15, docs only): where a doc uses 'cents' as the money minor-unit NAME, replace with 'minor units' (MNT's minor unit is möngö/obsolete; the convention is whole-tögrög). Do NOT touch 06. Leave 'cents' only if it's part of a quoted US-context historical note.
Run .softhouse/verify-docs.sh — HARD 0, DRIFT must NOT increase. Handoff: every change by category (old->new+file), confirm no amount/rail re-migration and 06 untouched.
